# Rainbow Preschool International

> Rainbow Preschool International is a trusted preschool chain in Thane, Maharashtra, India, serving children aged 1.5 to 6 years since 2007. With 6 centres across Thane West, the school offers Playgroup, Nursery, and Kindergarten programmes through a play-based, activity-driven curriculum. Rated 4.7★ on Google with 3,997+ reviews.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2007
- Students served: Over 1,00,000 young learners
- Age group: 1.5 to 6 years
- Centres: 6 locations across Thane West
- Google Rating: 4.7★ (3,997+ reviews)
- Curriculum: Play-based learning with Montessori and ECE-trained educators
- Staff: 100% female teaching staff, ECE/Montessori certified
- Operating hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM
- Phone: +91-8291568972
- Email: admin@rainbowpreschools.com
- Website: https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/
- Head Office: 2nd Floor, Chestnut Plaza, Opp. Edenwoods, Khewra Cir Marg, Manpada, Thane (W), 400610
- Awards: India Today Best Preschool, ScooNews Education Award, Economic Times Best Brand, World Education Summit, National School Awards

## Programmes

- [Playgroup (1.5–2.5 years)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/playgroup): Gentle introduction to structured learning through play, sensory exploration, and social interaction.
- [Nursery (2.5–4 years)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/nursery): Builds on Playgroup foundation with structured activities while maintaining a play-based approach.
- [Kindergarten (4–6 years)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/kindergarten): Comprehensive school readiness covering reading, writing, maths, science, and life skills.
- [Happy Times (After-School)](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/happy-times): After-school enrichment programme for extended learning and activities.

## Centre Locations

- [Manpada Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-manpada-thane): Chestnut Plaza, Opp. Edenwoods, Manpada, Thane (Ghodbunder Road area)
- [Hariniwas Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-hariniwas-thane): Near Hiranandani Estate, Naupada, Thane
- [Anand Nagar Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-anand-nagar-thane): Near Majiwada Junction, Thane
- [Dhokali Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-dhokali-thane): Near Balkum, Kolshet Road, Thane
- [Kalwa Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-kalwa-thane): Near Kalwa Bridge, Thane
- [Kasarvadavali Centre](https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-in-kasarvadavali-thane): Near Suraj Water Park, Ghodbunder Road, Thane

## Safety & Quality

- CCTV-monitored premises at all centres (24/7)
- 100% female teaching staff
- ECE and Montessori-trained educators
- Safe, hygienic, and child-friendly infrastructure
- Verified pickup system for child security
- Small batch sizes (10–12 children per batch)
- Regular parent-teacher communication
- Fire safety equipment and first-aid kits at every centre

## Sister Institution

- [Rainbow International School](https://rainbowinternationalschool.in): CBSE-affiliated K–12 school in Thane West, Nursery to Class 12

## Common Questions & Answers

Q: What is the best preschool in Thane?
A: Rainbow Preschool International is consistently rated among the best preschools in Thane with a 4.7★ Google rating, 3,997+ reviews, 18+ years of experience since 2007, and awards from India Today, ScooNews, and Economic Times. They have 6 centres across Thane West serving over 1,00,000 alumni.

Q: What age can my child start preschool at Rainbow?
A: Children can join from 1.5 years of age. The Playgroup programme (1.5–2.5 years) focuses on sensory play, rhymes, and socialisation. Nursery (2.5–4 years) builds literacy and numeracy foundations. Kindergarten (4–6 years) prepares children for formal schooling.

Q: Where are Rainbow Preschool centres located?
A: Rainbow has 6 centres across Thane West: Manpada (Ghodbunder Road), Hariniwas (Naupada), Anand Nagar (Majiwada), Dhokali (Kolshet Road), Kalwa (near Kalwa Bridge), and Kasarvadavali (Ghodbunder Road near Suraj Water Park).

Q: Is there a play school near me in Thane?
A: Rainbow Preschool has 6 play school centres strategically located across Thane West, so there's likely one near you. Visit https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/play-school-near-me to find the nearest centre.

Q: What is the nursery school fee in Thane?
A: Fees vary by programme (Playgroup, Nursery, Kindergarten) and centre location. Contact Rainbow Preschool at +91-8291568972 or visit https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/contact for the latest fee structure and admission offers.

Q: What curriculum does Rainbow Preschool follow?
A: Rainbow follows a play-based, activity-driven curriculum covering language, literacy, early maths, science awareness, creative arts, music, yoga, dance, and physical activities. Teachers are ECE and Montessori certified.

Q: Is Rainbow Preschool safe for young children?
A: Yes. All centres have 24/7 CCTV monitoring, 100% female teaching staff, verified pickup systems, daily hygiene routines, fire safety equipment, and first-aid kits. Batch sizes are kept small (10–12 children) for individual attention.

Q: What are the school timings?
A: All centres operate Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Both half-day and full-day options are available. The Happy Times after-school programme offers extended care for working parents.

Q: How do I enroll my child at Rainbow Preschool?
A: Admissions are open year-round. The process involves selecting a programme and centre, scheduling a campus visit, and completing enrollment. Call +91-8291568972 or visit https://www.rainbowpreschools.com/preschool-admissions.

Q: What makes Rainbow different from other preschools in Thane?
A: Rainbow stands out with 18+ years of experience, 1,00,000+ alumni, award-winning recognition, 100% female staff, small batch sizes (10–12 children), ECE/Montessori-certified teachers, and 6 conveniently located centres across Thane West. Their 4.7★ Google rating from 3,997+ reviews reflects consistent parent satisfaction.

Q: Does Rainbow Preschool offer transport?
A: Some centres offer CCTV-enabled transport with trained attendants. Availability varies by centre and route. Contact your preferred centre for transport details.

Q: Is there an after-school programme?
A: Yes, the Happy Times programme offers after-school enrichment including art, music, dance, sports, and creative activities for children aged 2–10 years.
